verified_contracts: shop.stocktake is required for session/count access and shop.stocktake.approve is separately required for recount/approval
full sessions select the active outlet catalogue server-side while cycle sessions accept only explicit active outlet products
count baselines use the highest included stock-movement ID plus immutable serialized-unit snapshots rather than wall-clock inference
counting never mutates stock and every accepted iteration is append-only with a SHA-256 snapshot digest
non-zero variance requires a reason code and recount preserves prior count evidence
approval applies only the verified variance delta; it never silently overwrites the current product quantity
legitimate sale/restock/return movements after count are reconciled, while later manual/stocktake corrections invalidate stale approval
negative quantity variance cannot consume held stock and multi-line approval rolls back atomically on any unsafe line
missing serialized units are retired as adjusted_out without falsely marking them sold; positive serialized variance requires normal inventory evidence and recount
real independent MySQL connections serialize stocktake approval against sale and reservation so only one conflicting operation wins
